notes.title: New Cosmos Kitten Demo Version!
notes.content:
A new demo version 0.1.4.3 has been released!  We've been hard at work on the game, and updates in the past month include:
-Character selection screen
-New playable classes
-New "Station" stage
-Combustion upgrades
-Health Regen upgrade
-Inputs guide
-Improved pause and game over screens
-Boss damage bar
-Damage numbers option
-Aiming options
-User interface improvements
-Dash improvements
-Visual effect improvements
-Other upgrade improvements
